=== intro

  Welcome! HA NOVA lets your AI assistant run your Home Assistant.

  Steps: pick your AI app, find Home Assistant, add the NOVA App, connect this computer, add the skills.
  When a browser page opens, finish there and come back here.
  You need the Home Assistant owner's account.
  Home Assistant Link only: the NOVA App must already be installed.

=== incomplete: relay_unreachable

  <ESC>[31m✗<ESC>[0m Setup incomplete

  HA NOVA saved your setup, but couldn't reach the NOVA App yet.
  In Home Assistant, open Settings → Apps → NOVA Relay (older Home Assistant: Settings > Add-ons) and start it.
  Then run "ha-nova setup" again — it continues where you left off.


=== incomplete: ws_degraded

  <ESC>[31m✗<ESC>[0m Setup incomplete

  The NOVA App answers, but it isn't connected to Home Assistant yet.
  In Home Assistant, open Settings → Apps → NOVA Relay (older Home Assistant: Settings > Add-ons). Check its settings, then restart it.
  Then run "ha-nova setup" again — it continues where you left off.
